text.markup:
**Once per Turn Action** -- {r}: Cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes an additional {r} this turn. **Go again**
**Arcane Barrier 1** _(If your hero would be dealt arcane damage, you may pay {r} instead. If you do, prevent 1 arcane damage that source would deal.)_
**Blade Break** _(If you defend with Heart of Ice, destroy it when the combat chain closes.)_
